summary: This topic explains the process of logging into the ERP system, identifying the default entity, and switching to a specific testing entity for daily operations.
steps: Navigate to the ERP login URL: campus.audipay.in (or campus.audier.in).
Log in using your registered mobile number.
Enter the One-Time Password (OTP) received on your mobile number.
Upon successful login, the 'Team Okidoki' entity will open by default. Do not perform any actions on this entity.
To switch to your assigned testing entity, click the icon at the top of the screen and select 'Select Entity'.
important_notes: The 'Team Okidoki' entity is a default system entity; no operational actions should be performed within it.
Always switch to your designated testing entity to perform daily tasks and configurations.
